plain_description: Gemma 4 is Google DeepMind's open-weights multimodal model family, engineered with an encoder-free architecture for fast text and image understanding on consumer hardware. Runs efficiently on laptops, edge devices, and local workstations without relying on cloud APIs.
technical_description: Gemma 4 is an open-weights multimodal vision-language model trained using knowledge distillation from Google Gemini research. It employs an encoder-free unified transformer architecture that directly consumes interleaved visual tokens and text tokens, reducing memory footprint and latency during multi-turn image-text dialogue and document visual question answering.
title: Gemma 4
